modalities.evidence: functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data from 50 participants
high-resolution structural images (T1-weighted and T2-weighted images)
we collected behavioural and functional magnetic resonance imaging

output.population: 50 human participants: 26 younger adults aged 18–34 years and 24 older adults aged 63–80 years, described as healthy/control
output.summary: Behavioural and fMRI data from younger and older adults completing an economic trust game, a shared card-guessing task and an ultimatum game, plus B0 field maps and T1- and T2-weighted structural images.
